tutorIntro: You can work through this app with an AI assistant of your choice. It gets instructions, the prompt, which explain the app, its pages and tasks. The app sends nothing anywhere. Only your click on an assistant opens it; what you write there goes to its provider.
tutorPageIntro: Your tutor gets this page with the tasks you have in front of you, with solutions to guide you. The app sends nothing anywhere; only your click opens the assistant.
tutorPageNow: The learner is on this page, with these tasks (the numbers are in the address):
tutorShortNote: If you cannot fetch a file, tell me: the full text is in my clipboard, and I will paste it to you.
tutorCopied: The prompt is copied. Paste it into the chat of your AI assistant.
tutorCopiedShort: The prompt is copied as well. If the chat shows only a short sentence, paste it there.
tutorCopyFailed: Copying did not work. Open the prompt as text and copy it from there.
